reason: It hits my exact problem, since typing openers by hand eats my day, but $147 is nearly a tenth of what I make in a month and there are no customer results anywhere. I'm not putting a card down on a tool nobody has proven yet.
objection: Zero published results and $147 a month on a card that locks me in after day 3. Three days isn't enough to see if one DM turns into a reply, let alone a client, and then payments are final. It also still needs my Chrome and an Instagram tab open, so I'd be babysitting it anyway, and I worry about my account getting flagged.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from people at my size, like replies and booked calls from a handful of named users, plus a longer trial or a refund window of at least 14 days. A price around $49 to $79 would also get me to try it.
